payload.body: vc, 2026-10-17, after your AFK word. After your cut: kovacs-sysadm brew installs Intent on kovacs and reports the version; vc orders dc to remove tmp/wt-dc-kd324 and cc tmp/wt-cc-0083, then the globalfold. IF YOU WOULD RATHER vc RAN THE CUT, the one route is your explicit authorisation of --no-confirm for this one release, by name, stating what it pushes (the v3.2.4 tag and main to upstream, the GitHub release and its five assets, the tap formula), as at 3.0.1.
